# Bundled presentation runtime

Reveal.js JavaScript and CSS come from https://github.com/hakimel/reveal.js/tree/master/dist and retain their MIT license in `reveal/LICENSE`. Small local reset and theme files support the supplied offline deck. The Quarto source uses Quarto's own Reveal.js runtime when rebuilt with Quarto.

No external fonts, scripts, or stylesheets are required to view the supplied `docs/slides.html`.
